versions.content: Ethernet Switch Configuration Type: valid Description: Ethernet Switch Configuration shall provide standardized artifacts to describe the structure of egress ports, port scheduling mechanisms as well as the forwarding process within the switch. Common parameters which can be written to a switch, e.g. during the initialization phase, need to be integrated in the system description. Rationale: The timing behavior of messages within the switch depends on the configuration of switches. Therefore, the switch behavior needs to be described. Dependencies: – Use Case: Provide the description of an Ethernet topology including the model for switches and their behavior. Supporting Material: –
